title: Senior Data Centre Specialist
full_description:
Rotterdam, Netherlands
€5.485,70 - €8.828,03
The team that you will be joining is a multidisciplinary and cross-functional team with end-to-end responsibility for Global Data Centres Services and the delivery of these services to ING’s business. You will work closely together with the other teams within ING. As Senior Data Centre Infrastructure Engineer you are a member of the Global Data Centres Services department, team OPS2.
This team is responsible for all activities within the white space of the ING Data Centres. These activities include:
Managing the overall capacity planning for power, cooling, space and networking for optimal Data Centre usage and scalability
Physical access and security to all data halls
Supervise and coordinate physical IMACD activities (Install, Move, Add Change or Decommissioning of ICT infrastructure) and check the work performed Install and maintaining the Power Distribution Units in the data halls
Managing applications such as Data Centre Infrastructure Management (DCIM) and Lock management
Automating our processes and applications
Roles and responsibilities
As a Senior Data Centre Infrastructure engineer, you will be responsible for the physical deployment and maintenance of critical IT hardware and cabling systems. Your key tasks include:
Installing, cabling, and powering servers, storage, and network equipment and also be a supervisor for these tasks.
Building and maintaining cold/hot aisle containment to optimize airflow and efficiency
Executing structured copper and fiber optic cabling, including testing and labelling
Performing advanced fiber optic procedures such as fusion splicing and OTDR analysis
Installing cable tray systems and managing physical infrastructure scalability
Configuring server management interfaces (e.g., iLO, iDRAC) per instructions
Troubleshooting Layer 1/2 connectivity issues and resolving hardware faults
Using DCIM and ticketing systems for asset tracking and incident management
Documenting cable routes, asset data, and changes
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
You at least have a diploma in IT, Electrical Engineering or related technical discipline
You must have basic knowledge of electrical safety standards, preferably NEN3140 (VOP Minimum, VP preferred)
You have strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and Dutch
You have a valid drivers license (B) and willing to travel between our datacentre sites
You have the flexibility to work outside of standard business hours when necessary
You can lead projects, create work instructions, do quality assurance and 'give hands' to the people who need it
Team oriented mindset with hands on attitude and attention to detail
You have proven experience in datacenter infrastructures, like rack and stack, cold/hot aisle containment and structured cabling
Advanced knowledge of fiber optics: installation, splicing, OTDR testing, troubleshooting (SingleMode and MultiMode OS2/OM4/OM5)
Strong diagnostic skills in physical and data link layer networking, including resolution of port failures and signal degradation
Skilled at identifying, isolating and resolving connectivity issues (loops, bad ports, mismatched optics, etc.)
Familiarity with cable documentation standards and physical network design principles
An extra advantage is when you have previous work experience in Electrical Engineering
The locations are Rotterdam and Roosendaal
You do not mind to participate in stand-by
Ability to work non-office hours
Rewards and benefitsWe want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life.https://careers.ing.com/en/benefits-NL
The benefits of working with us at ING include:
25-28 vacation days depending on contract
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
